```{r, message = FALSE}
library(kernelshap)
library(shapviz)
library(readxl)
library(tensorflow)
library(keras3)
library(dplyr)
library(zoo)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
tf$random$set_seed(1)
```

```{r}
infections <- read_excel("Data/Infections.xlsx")
infections$date <- as.Date(infections$date)
```

```{r}
infections$day <- as.numeric(infections$date - as.Date("2019-11-30"))
infections$fog <- as.factor(infections$fog)
infections$thunder <- as.factor(infections$thunder)
infections$dust <- as.factor(infections$dust)
infections$smoke <- as.factor(infections$smoke)
infections$estpos <- ifelse(infections$posencounters == 0, 0, (infections$posencounters / infections$restests) * infections$encounters)
```

```{r}
reduced <- infections[,c(1, 6, 4, 2, 20, 21, 32, 33, 9, 10, 11, 12)]
reduced <- reduced %>%
  arrange(day) %>%
  mutate(
    date = date,
    estpos = rollmean(estpos, k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    maxtemp = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(maxtemp, k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    precip = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(precip, k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    wind = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(wind, k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    pm10 = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(pm10, k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    pm2.5 = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(pm2.5, k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    dir2 = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(dir2, k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    dir5 = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(dir5, k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    maxwind1 = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(maxwind1, k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    maxwind2 = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(maxwind2, k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right")))
  )
reduced <- na.omit(reduced)
lancet <- reduced[, -c(1, 6, 9, 10, 11)]
```

```{r}
window <- 365
horizon <- 10
samples <- nrow(lancet) - window - horizon + 1

x <- array(NA, dim = c(samples, window, ncol(lancet) - 1))
y <- array(NA, dim = c(samples, horizon))

for (i in 1:samples) {
  x[i,,] <- as.matrix(lancet[i:(i + window - 1), 1:(ncol(lancet) - 1)])
  y[i, ] <- as.numeric(unlist(
    lancet[(i + window):(i + window + horizon - 1), ncol(lancet)]
  ))
}
```

```{r}
test_days <- 90
  
x_train <- x[1:(samples - test_days),,]
y_train <- y[1:(samples - test_days), ]

x_test  <- x[(samples - test_days + 1):samples,,]
y_test  <- y[(samples - test_days + 1):samples, ]
```

```{r}
model <- load_model("final.keras")
```

```{r}
feature_names <- colnames(lancet)[1:(ncol(lancet) - 1)]
```

```{r}
X_shap <- apply(x, c(1, 3), mean)
colnames(X_shap) <- feature_names
X_shap <- as.data.frame(X_shap)
```

```{r}
pred_fun <- function(X) {
  X_lstm <- array(
    as.numeric(as.matrix(X)),
    dim = c(
      nrow(X),
      dim(x)[2],   # 365-day window
      ncol(X)      # features
    )
  )
  
  preds <- predict(model, X_lstm)
  as.numeric(preds[, horizon])  # explain day-30 forecast
}
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)

bg_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(X_shap)), 50)
X_bg <- X_shap[bg_idx, ]

X_explain <- X_shap[1:100, ]
```

```{r}
dummy_model <- list()
class(dummy_model) <- "shap_dummy"

predict.shap_dummy <- function(object, newdata, ...) {
  pred_fun(newdata)
}

shap_vals <- kernelshap(
  object = dummy_model,
  X = X_explain,
  bg_X = X_bg
)
```


```{r}
sv <- shapviz(shap_vals, X_explain)
```

```{r}
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

shap_long <- as.data.frame(sv$S) |>
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -row_id,
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "shap"
  )

x_long <- as.data.frame(sv$X) |>
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -row_id,
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "value"
  )

plot_df <- left_join(shap_long, x_long,
                     by = c("row_id", "feature"))

feature_order <- plot_df |>
  group_by(feature) |>
  summarise(imp = mean(abs(shap))) |>
  arrange(imp) |>
  pull(feature)

plot_df$feature <- factor(plot_df$feature,
                           levels = feature_order)

library(scales)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = shap, y = feature, color = value)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.2, size = 1.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    trans = pseudo_log_trans(base = 10)
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "SHAP value (pseudo-log scale, day-10 prediction)",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Feature value"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)

plot_df <- data.frame(
  shap    = as.vector(sv$S),
  feature = rep(colnames(sv$S), each = nrow(sv$S)),
  value   = as.vector(as.matrix(sv$X))
)

plot_df$feature <- factor(
  plot_df$feature,
  levels = rev(names(sort(colMeans(abs(sv$S)), decreasing = TRUE)))
)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = shap, y = feature)) +

  # density (thickness)
  geom_violin(
    fill = "grey90",
    scale = "width",
    trim = TRUE
  ) +

  # individual SHAP points
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = value),
    height = 0.15,
    size = 1.4,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +

  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C", name = "Feature value") +

  scale_x_continuous(
    trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 1e-4)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "SHAP value (impact on prediction)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Feature influence on 10‑day LSTM prediction"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

```{r}
plot_df$shap_abs <- abs(plot_df$shap)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = shap, y = feature)) +

  # violin = density / thickness
  geom_violin(
    aes(fill = shap_abs),
    scale = "width",
    trim = TRUE,
    color = NA,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  # points = individual contributions
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = shap_abs),
    height = 0.15,
    size = 1.4,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +

  # SHAP-style color
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "C",
    name = "|SHAP value|",
    trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 1e-4)
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "C",
    guide = "none",
    trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 1e-4)
  ) +

  # pseudo-log SHAP axis
  scale_x_continuous(
    trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 1e-4)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "SHAP value (impact on 10-day prediction)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "SHAP summary plot (LSTM, day-10 forecast)"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
shap_raw <- predict(
  model_xgb,
  dtrain,
  predcontrib = TRUE
)

shap_df <- as.data.frame(shap_raw)

shap_bias <- shap_df$BIAS
shap_df$BIAS <- NULL

dim(shap_df)
```

```{r}
base_features <- colnames(lancet)[1:num_features]
timesteps <- 120

feature_names <- as.vector(
  sapply(1:timesteps, function(t)
    paste0(base_features, "_t-", timesteps - t + 1))
)

colnames(shap_df) <- feature_names
shap_df <- shap_df[, !is.na(colnames(shap_df))]
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

shap_long <- shap_df |>
  mutate(id = row_number()) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -id,
    names_to = "feature_lag",
    values_to = "shap"
  ) |>
  separate(
    feature_lag,
    into = c("feature", "lag"),
    sep = "_t-",
    remove = FALSE
  )

shap_feature <- shap_long |>
  group_by(feature) |>
  summarise(
    mean_abs_shap = mean(abs(shap)),
    mean_shap     = mean(shap)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(mean_abs_shap))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(shap_feature,
       aes(x = reorder(feature, mean_abs_shap),
           y = mean_abs_shap)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#1f77b4") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean |SHAP value|",
    title = "XGBoost Feature Importance (SHAP, 10‑day forecast)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

lstm_imp <- plot_df |>
  group_by(feature) |>
  summarise(
    mean_abs_shap = mean(abs(shap), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(model = "LSTM")

xgb_imp <- shap_df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "feature_lag",
    values_to = "shap"
  ) |>
  tidyr::separate(
    feature_lag,
    into = c("feature", "lag"),
    sep = "_t-",
    remove = FALSE
  ) |>
  group_by(feature) |>
  summarise(
    mean_abs_shap = mean(abs(shap), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(model = "GBDT")

combined_imp <- bind_rows(lstm_imp, xgb_imp)

feature_order <- combined_imp |>
  group_by(feature) |>
  summarise(overall = mean(mean_abs_shap)) |>
  arrange(overall) |>
  pull(feature)

combined_imp$feature <- factor(
  combined_imp$feature,
  levels = feature_order
)

combined_imp <- combined_imp |>
  filter(feature != "estpos")

combined_imp <- combined_imp |>
  filter(!is.na(model))

pretty_names <- c(
  "day"        = "Day",
  "pm2.5"      = "PM 2.5",
  "pm10"       = "PM 10",
  "maxtemp"    = "Temperature",
  "wind"       = "Wind Speed",
  "precip"     = "Precipitation"
)

combined_imp <- combined_imp |>
  mutate(
    feature_chr    = as.character(feature),
    feature_pretty = dplyr::recode(feature_chr, !!!pretty_names)
  )

feature_order <- combined_imp |>
  group_by(feature_pretty) |>
  summarise(overall_imp = mean(mean_abs_shap, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(overall_imp) |>
  pull(feature_pretty)

combined_imp <- combined_imp |>
  mutate(
    feature_pretty = factor(feature_pretty, levels = feature_order)
  )

combined_imp$model <- factor(
  combined_imp$model,
  levels = c("LSTM", "GBDT")
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(combined_imp,
       aes(x = mean_abs_shap, y = feature_pretty, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7, reverse = TRUE), width = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "LSTM" = "#1f77b4",
      "GBDT" = "#d62728"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 1e-4),
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 3)   # ← fewer labels
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean |SHAP|",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Model",
    title = "LSTM and GBDT Feature Importance"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
```
